purpose: Freeze record for the two judge rubrics. `digest` is the first 16 hex characters of `sha256`, which is the value src/eval/judge.py:template_digest computes and records as `template_sha256` in each judge artefact -- so a run's recorded digest can be checked against this file rather than asserted from a config.

judge_eval.txt.role: evaluation-time rubric; scores the reported Phi
judge_eval.txt.note: Unchanged since the 2026-08-05 cross-family pass, whose rater-B artefacts record digest ffd6dad41acb0512. Rater A's artefacts predate digest recording, so `template_verified` stays false in results/judge_agreement_gpt_val.json; this record does not close that gap retrospectively.

judge_train.txt.role: training-time rubric; the Phi term of the RLSF reward
judge_train.txt.note: Frozen before any RLSF run, so every reward call this template serves is digest-checkable. Verified on load by src/rlsf/reward.py:load_train_template.
